@BRICSinfo China is facing a new virus outbreak with the Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) spreading rapidly, causing flu-like and COVID-19-like symptoms.

Is this real?

nodes.author: dontbemeantome1
nodes.text:
FACTS:

While social media reports suggest a crisis, no official emergency has been declared by Chinese authorities or the WHO!

MMPV has been around since 2001 it’s not a new virus similar to the flu and belongs to the Pneumoviridae family, similar to the respiratory syncytial virus (RSV).

Transmission — The virus spreads through respiratory droplets from coughing or sneezing and close contact with infected individuals.

Seasonality — HMPV infections typically peak in late winter and spring, aligning with other respiratory illnesses.

Vulnerable Groups — Young children, older adults, and individuals with weakened immune systems are at higher risk of severe illness from HMPV.

Severity — While HMPV can cause severe respiratory issues, it is not considered a new or imminent pandemic threat.

This is all readily available information. People should stop getting so excited and research the facts for themselves.
